Journal of Synthetic Studies · 12

1. Équations and quotations
The equation $E=mc^2$ is preserved, as is $\int_0^1 x^2\,dx=1/3$.
The quotation “λόγος καὶ ἀλήθεια” and « 日本語の引用 » remain in their original languages.
Compare [1] Smith, 2020, p. 7; the repeated citation is [1] Smith, 2020, p. 7.
An OCR footnote[^p1-1] points to the definition.

[^p1-1]: Printed note 1: é is decomposed; é is composed. Emoji 😀 is one scalar, two UTF-16 units.
